question:
(The following bar chart shows the income and expenditure (in lakhs) of five companies (P, Q, R, S, T) in the year 2020. The percentage profit or loss of a company is given by:

{(Profit or loss) \%} = (I - E)/(E) times 100 ; {where } I = {income, } E = {expenditure} 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ae80d172fa881ccadaefea73dcd0b39e490583f0e77d07343039f45e51dce64.png] 

"If the income of company R in 2020 was 10% more than its income in 2019 and the company had earned a profit of 30% in 2019, then its approximate expenditure in 2019 (in lakhs) was:
solution:
**Given:**

Income of company R in 2020 = ₹88 lakhs

Income of company R in 2019 = ₹88 / 1.10

Profit in 2019 = 30%

**Formula used:**

(Profit or loss) % = (I - E) / E × 100

Where, I = income, E = expenditure

**Calculations:**

Income of company R in 2019 = ₹88 / 1.10 = ₹80 lakhs

30 = (80 - E) / E × 100

⇒ 30E = 8000 - 100E

⇒ 130E = 8000

⇒ E = 8000/130

⇒ E ≈ ₹61.54 lakhs

**∴ The correct answer is option 1 (₹61.54 lakhs).**
